name: OPA828 / OPA2828
tagline: TI's 2018 'next-generation OPA627': 4 nV/√Hz, 45 MHz, 150 V/µs, −130 dB THD+N. Rollers call it extremely neutral.

lineage.note: SBOS671 from Sep 2018; SOIC single until DGN single and OPA2828 dual added 2022. Sole source.
TI positions it as next-generation OPA627/OPA827; different die and process (SiGe BiFET vs Difet).

part_numbers.note: SOIC-8, marked 'OPA828'; tube 75 / reel 2500. ID/IDR under PCN20221117006 (spec only).
HVSSOP-8 PowerPAD, marked '2RAJ'; tighter DC specs, lower CMRR. Production since Rev D.
HVSSOP-8 PowerPAD only, marked '2QGJ'; standard pinout. Solder pad to V− or GND.
Duplicate rows in 2025 addenda; a TI-wide convention, meaning unexplained. Duals are 2-channel.

key_specs.value: 0.000028% (−130 dB); IMD CCIF 137 dB, SMPTE 132 dB
5.5 mA typ / 6.2 mA max per amp (7.9 mA at 125 °C)
SiGe JFET; CM (V−)+2.5 V to (V+)−3.5 V; 10¹² Ω

reputation.summary: Rollers treat it as the modern OPA627, as TI positions it. In diyAudio's 'OPA828 / OPA2828 vs OPA627' thread users call it extremely neutral, very transparent, detailed and fatigue-free, above the OPA1642, with no oscillation even on breadboards; OPA627 fans may find it 'thin'. The Q17 power amp swapped its OPA1641 for OPA828. No ASR or Samuel Groner measurements.
typical_uses: line buffers, preamps and RIAA phono stages
headphone amps with a separate buffer (OPA828 + LME49600)
rolling on SOIC-to-DIP adapters (Audiophonics DIP8 unit)
caveats: No DIP; adapters add parasitics. Solder the DGN pad to V− or GND.
Fast: isolate capacitive loads (e.g. 50 Ω); layout and decoupling matter.
Slew-boost engages when inputs are driven far apart and 'can distort the signal' in overload.
Not rail-to-rail despite 'RRO' blurbs: needs ±4 V and 0.9–1.2 V output headroom.
5.5 mA per channel heats SOIC ~20 °C; JFET bias rises steeply with temperature.

counterfeit_notes: No counterfeits documented. TI makes no DIP: any DIP 'OPA828/OPA2828' is an adapter. OPA2828 exists only as HVSSOP-8 marked '2QGJ'; SOIC OPA828 is marked 'OPA828', DGN '2RAJ'. Check marking, ~150 V/µs slew and pA bias.

silicon_changes.identification: No marking or orderable change; parts are physically identical. Only the datasheet differs: SBOS671B (Dec 2018) old limits, SBOS671C/D revised limits.
silicon_changes.summary: 'Same part number, different datasheet', not a die change. PCN20221117006 revised SOIC OPA828ID/IDR limits 'to accurately reflect device characteristics', with no device or fit/form/function change. Changed parameters unknown; possibly linked to a 2019 E2E output-swing report. Falls between Rev C (Oct 2022) and Rev D (Dec 2022).

spec_deltas.parameter: OPA828ID/IDR datasheet limits (specific parameters not identified)

silicon_changes.audio_impact: None expected: silicon unchanged; noise, GBW, slew and THD+N typicals match Rev B and Rev D.
silicon_changes.compatibility_risk: low: spec-only, same device and marking; re-check budgets qualified against Rev B limits.
silicon_changes.verification: DigiKey-hosted PCN confirmed to cover OPA828ID/IDR; the revised parameter is still unidentified.

silicon_changes.identification: DGN suffix (HVSSOP-8 PowerPAD) vs D (SOIC-8). Marking '2RAJ' (OPA828) or '2QGJ' (OPA2828) vs 'OPA828'. Specs first in Rev C/D.
silicon_changes.summary: Package extension, no documented die change. TI added a thermally enhanced DGN single (SBOS671C preview, SBOS671D production) and the OPA2828 dual in DGN only, with tighter DC specs than SOIC. New silicon or just different trim/test is unknown. AC specs are shared.

spec_deltas.parameter: Input bias and offset current typ / max @25C
spec_deltas.after: DGN: +/-0.2 pA / +/-5 pA (front page says 0.1 pA)

silicon_changes.audio_impact: Negligible: DC precision and a few dB of CMRR differ; AC specs identical. DGN runs cooler; dual needs a PowerPAD adapter.
silicon_changes.compatibility_risk: low: different footprints, suffixes and markings; OPA2828 only in HVSSOP-8 with exposed pad.
silicon_changes.verification: Deltas from the current TI datasheet. Whether DGN uses different silicon is unknown.

revision_history.changes: Not itemised in SBOS671D, whose history starts at A→B.
First production data: single OPA828 in SOIC-8 (typ 50 µV, 0.45 µV/°C, 1 pA). Limits predate PCN20221117006.
Added DGN preview for OPA828 and OPA2828, PowerPAD section and missing Equation 2; edited operating conditions. DGN spec split likely here.
Spec change for OPA828ID/IDR 'to accurately reflect device characteristics'; no device or identification change. Parameters unknown.
DGN moved to production. Header misdates Rev C as December 2018. PDF rebuilt with 2025 addenda (2025-07-26, 2026-08-11 builds).
Model referencing SBOS671B. 1.1: Aol, GBW, phase margin, CLAW, Isc, Vos fixes; 1.2: IQ fix; 1.3: noiseless resistor. Model only.
Japanese translation covering OPA828 and OPA2828; letter likely tracks English SBOS671D.

revision_chains.note: No confirmed copies of original, A or C. Wayback captures (2018–2022) of the symlink PDF are best.
Kyohritsu singular-title copy is probably an earlier letter. Dates unknown.

open_questions: Which OPA828ID/IDR limits did PCN20221117006 change? Diff SBOS671B against SBOS671D or read the PCN.
Did the 2019 E2E output-swing report (thread 801601) prompt the PCN? An early '50-MHz' description is also unexplained.
Which revisions do the Octopart, MSU, alldatasheet 1082236/1477199 and ic114 copies hold?
Is DGN silicon revised, or the same die with different trim, test or package? What do '.B' rows mean?
Any independent THD or IMD measurements (ASR, Samuel Groner)?

claims_confirmed: Current datasheet is SBOS671D (Sep 2018, revised Dec 2022); OPA828 in D and DGN, OPA2828 in DGN only: https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/opa828.pdf
Separate OPA828 and OPA2828 product folders and an OPA828ID part page: https://www.ti.com/product/OPA2828 , https://www.ti.com/product/OPA828/part-details/OPA828ID

PCN20221117006 covers OPA828ID/IDR, spec change only, no device or identification change: https://mm.digikey.com/Volume0/opasdata/d220001/medias/docus/5336/PCN20221117006.0.pdf (Mouser: https://www.mouser.com/PCN/Texas_Instruments_PCN20221117006_2022111813034746.pdf)
Swing 0.9 V typ / 1.2 V max from rails at ±15 V, 10 kΩ (±14.1 / ±13.8 V); a slam test: https://e2e.ti.com/support/amplifiers-group/amplifiers/f/amplifiers-forum/990426/opa828-output-voltage-swing

diyAudio 'OPA828 / OPA2828 vs OPA627' thread: neutral, wide soundstage, transparent, 'thin' to OPA627 fans, no oscillation: https://www.diyaudio.com/community/threads/opa828-opa2828-vs-opa627.400109/page-2
Audiophonics sells an 'OPA828 Dual OPA DIP8' adapter: https://www.audiophonics.fr/en/opa/opa828-p-21403.html

2019 E2E thread: output-swing spec disagreed with datasheet figures (Rev B era): https://e2e.ti.com/support/amplifiers-group/amplifiers/f/amplifiers-forum/801601/opa828-output-swing-specification-disagrees-with-datasheet-figures
refuted_claims: SOIC OPA828 did not keep its 2018 specification: PCN20221117006 (Nov 2022) changed OPA828ID/IDR datasheet limits (spec only). https://mm.digikey.com/Volume0/opasdata/d220001/medias/docus/5336/PCN20221117006.0.pdf
